delivery-dev.starting_role: custom deployment role scoped to a development resource group

release-prod.starting_role: custom least-privilege role scoped to approved resources

microsoft_store.warning: Partner Center roles may not restrict EXE/MSI applications as expected; validate effective access with a dedicated test product.

rules: Never use Global Administrator, Azure Owner or Partner Center account owner in routine CI.
Scope Azure identities to the smallest management group, subscription or resource group possible.
Separate control-plane from data-plane roles and separate development from production identities.
Treat HTTP 401 as authentication failure and HTTP 403 as permission or scope drift.
Require two-person approval for RBAC, policy, billing, production deployment, Store publication and destructive actions.
